name: RemoteOK — all remote jobs
notes: Disabled: worked on the first two pipeline runs (2026-09-13) but returned HTTP 410 on the third, made ~6 minutes later from a GitHub Actions runner. That pattern (works, works, suddenly Gone, after repeated automated requests in a short window) looks like RemoteOK bot-blocking rather than a real outage. Not worth having the scheduled cron fail against every 6 hours. Re-enable and watch it if you want to try again later, ideally at a lower request frequency.

name: Opportunities for Youth (scholarships/fellowships/competitions)
notes: Global youth-opportunity aggregator (scholarships, fellowships, competitions, internships). Confirmed live and working via an actual pipeline run (2026-09-13). Expect a global mix rather than Philippines-specific or exclusively business-focused postings; the heuristic scorer's accessibility/relevance dimensions should down-rank poor fits rather than needing this source pre-filtered.
